parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description: The bucket that stores the data cache. Default value: default.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum entries of query results that are allowed to be displayed. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value that is returned in the previous call.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The virtual host (vHost) directory in which the data cache resides.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the data caches that you want to query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the data cache belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to the data cache.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci describe-data-caches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --data-cache-id edc-bp1a7n7uawwwol000000 --bucket default --path /data/models/ --tag Value=testvalue Key=testkey --resource-group-id rg-acfmzw2jz2z0000 --limit 20 --next-token d78f2dd8-5979-42fe-0000-b16db43be5bc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci DescribeDataCaches --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/data/models/' --Tag.1.Key testkey --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzw2jz2z0000' --NextToken 'd78f2dd8-5979-42fe-0000-b16db43be5bc' --Bucket default --DataCacheId.1 'edc-bp1a7n7uawwwol000000' --Tag.1.Value testvalue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Limit 20
